name: PERSON-SOLO1 observed 25-hour drift with progressive biphasic sleep

sleep_architecture.note: The sleep episode gradually split into two approximately equal sleep bouts; later a 2-3 hour waking interval appeared between them.

historical_caffeine.description: aggregate forcing proxy for the earlier 1-2 cups every day

current_caffeine.description: upper end of the current stated 3-4 cups per week

calibration_scope: Wake observations identify phase drift; sleep_architecture constrains fragmentation. Neither establishes caffeine as the cause.
